performance.representation: sparse Python sets; no dense U x P allocation

methodology.role_discovery: Exact access cohorts then bounded greedy support-signature factoring; best unit WSC candidate selected
methodology.optimization: Unit WSC = R + UA + PA; reconstructed edges checked for missing and extra grants; no global optimality claim
methodology.risk: 65% grant rarity fraction + 35% permission density; review signals, no confirmed-threat labels
methodology.attributes: ACL structural features only; no HR or temporal attributes inferred
methodology.reinforcement_learning: Offline terminal Q-learning uses genuine administrator review feedback only; no simulated rewards
methodology.data_scope: Named access-control benchmark, not an operational ERP integration
